newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Settlers wound Palestinian, shoot at reporters.
newsitem.headline: Settlers wound Palestinian, shoot at reporters.

text.p: Jewish settlers shot and wounded a Palestinian youth in Gaza on Monday during a clash over land which Arabs said had recently been seized by settlers, witnesses said.
They said a Jew from the Gush Katif settlement block fired at least three shots at three Palestinian journalists who arrived to cover a demonstration by Arab landowners.

"I shouted to the settler in Hebrew that we were reporters, but he cursed at us and continued to fire his pistol. One bullet barely missed us," a Reuters reporter said, describing the gunman as a middle-aged settler with a grey beard.
A settler spokesman said he knew of no such incident.
Israeli soldiers later arrived at the scene, punched a cameraman and kicked others, journalists said. One youth was shot in the knee and was taken to hospital.
